name: Meetings
description: Record meetings on this computer, or let the desktop app start when a meeting app uses your mic. Transcribed locally with Whisper, then Claude writes each one up for its kind of meeting, and links recurring ones so each picks up where the last left off.
author: cockpit

settings.label: When a meeting app uses your mic
settings.help: In the desktop app: ask to record it, record it straight away, or do nothing. Recording stops by itself when the app lets go of the mic

settings.label: Meeting apps
settings.help: part=Name, one per line. An app counts when its macOS bundle id or Linux program name contains the part

settings.label: Kinds of meeting
settings.help: Add or change kinds: [{"id": "sales", "name": "Sales call", "focus": "what to pay attention to", "sections": [{"title": "Objections", "hint": "what they pushed back on"}]}]. The same id as a built-in one replaces it

settings.label: Your name
settings.help: How you show in transcripts recorded with the computer's sound. Empty shows "You"

settings.label: Transcribe while recording
settings.help: Shows the transcript as the meeting goes, and makes the summary come faster at the end. Uses the GPU or CPU during the meeting

settings.label: Summary language
settings.help: Like English or Português. Empty writes it in the meeting's own language

settings.label: More for the summary
settings.help: Anything Claude should always do, like "list ticket keys mentioned" or "keep it under 150 words"

settings.label: Summary model
settings.help: A Claude model or alias, like sonnet. Empty uses your default

settings.label: Folder for Ask Claude
settings.help: Where Claude starts when you ask about a meeting, like your repo. Empty uses your home folder

settings.label: Transcription Python
settings.help: A Python with faster-whisper. The Meetings screen can set one up here for you

settings.label: Transcription model
settings.help: Any faster-whisper model. Smaller ones like small or medium are faster on a computer without a GPU
